name: hud_ui_slider_border_update
description: HudUiSliderBorder::Update skips hidden borders, advances blink timing, flips visibility phase when the timer expires, and draws only when visible.
known_limits: tier S verification remains deferred to the HudUiPolyline/HudUiSliderBorder source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja has an x87 flag-lift limitation around fcom/fnstsw/fstp in this function; assembly was used as the behavior source for blink timer comparison.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b47b0 validates early return when base flags include 0x10, blinkTimeRemainingSec -= deltaSeconds, timer-expired detection through x87 fcom/fnstsw, blinkDirSign negation plus timer reset to blinkPeriodSec, and drawing only when blink is disabled or blinkDirSign == 1.

Native smoke zhud_polyline_draw_and_slider_update_smoke verifies hidden skip, non-blinking draw, visible blink countdown, expired blink flipping hidden without drawing, and next expired blink flipping visible and drawing.
